meta.title: SFaster Laundry · One customer, one machine · Clean, fresh, fast
meta.description: SFaster laundry at 68 Lê Hồng Phong: wash & dry by weight from 35,000 ₫, duvets and bedding, dry cleaning, shoe cleaning, plush toys and toppers. Every customer gets their own machine. Open 7:00–19:00 every day.

hero.title: Clean, fresh laundry,
hero.text: At SFaster every customer gets their own machine: your clothes are washed and dried on their own, then bagged and labelled with your name. Priced by weight, from 35,000 ₫ a load.

loyalty.text: Every eighth wash is on us. Ask at the counter for the details.
loyalty.card: Loyalty card: 7 paid washes, the 8th free

tips.title: A few checks for the best result
items: Empty every pocket: money, papers, earphones, lighters.
Tell us about clothes that may bleed colour or need washing separately.
Choose dry cleaning for wool, silk, leather and suits.
Point out tough stains (oil, ink, makeup) when you drop off.
Keep your ticket: it's how we match your bag when you pick up.

items.q: Is my laundry washed with other people's?
items.a: No. SFaster works on one customer, one machine: each customer's laundry is washed and dried on its own.
Clothes and bedding are priced by the weight measured when you drop off; dry cleaning and other services are priced per item, pair or kilo (see the price list).

items.q: Can wool, silk, leather or suits go in the machine?
items.a: Those are better in our dry cleaning service, which keeps their shape and material. See the dry cleaning prices.

items.q: When can I pick my laundry up?
items.a: It depends on how much you bring and the service. Call or message us on Zalo and we'll tell you when it will be ready.

items.q: How does wash 7 times, get 1 free work?
items.a: After 7 paid washes, your next one is free. Ask at the counter for the details.
Every day from 7:00 to 19:00, except public holidays (Lễ, Tết).
